skill.name: theme-factory
skill.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with curated themes, including slides, documents, reports, and HTML landing pages. It provides ten preset themes with colors and fonts, and can help create a custom theme.
skill.summary: Applies curated color and font themes to presentations, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts.

content.value_statement: Consistent visual styling is slow across decks, reports, and web pages. Theme Factory applies curated color palettes and font pairings quickly.
actual_capabilities: Presents a PDF showcase of ten available themes.
Lists theme files with palettes, hex codes, font pairings, and best-fit contexts.
Applies selected colors and fonts to slides, documents, reports, or HTML artifacts.
Supports custom theme generation from user-provided style direction.
Guides explicit user confirmation before applying a chosen theme.
limitations: Does not include executable theme application scripts.
Requires an existing artifact or clear content direction to apply styling.
Uses available fonts named in the theme files; exact rendering depends on the target environment.
The PDF showcase is a bundled reference asset and is not editable by the skill.

use_cases.title: Restyle Client Decks
use_cases.description: Apply a professional visual identity to existing consulting or sales presentations.

use_cases.title: Prepare Campaign Materials
use_cases.description: Choose a theme that matches a campaign mood and apply it across reports or web drafts.

use_cases.title: Create Product Presentation Themes
use_cases.description: Generate or adapt a theme for launches, demos, and technical briefings.

prompt_templates.title: Show Theme Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the theme showcase and help me choose a theme for my presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Selected Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this slide deck. Keep the content unchanged and improve readability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Direct styling of an existing artifact

prompt_templates.title: Match a Business Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend three themes for a financial report aimed at executives. Explain the strengths of each choice.
prompt_templates.scenario: Theme selection based on audience and purpose

prompt_templates.title: Create a Custom Theme System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a healthcare product launch. Include palette, fonts, usage rules, and apply it after approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced theme creation and application workflow

output_examples.input: Apply Tech Innovation to a software launch deck.
output_examples.output: The deck uses electric blue accents, dark gray backgrounds, and strong contrast for product screenshots and launch metrics.

output_examples.input: Recommend a theme for an executive financial report.
output_examples.output: Ocean Depths is the strongest fit because it feels calm, credible, and professional for financial decision makers.

output_examples.input: Create a theme for a wellness brand proposal.
output_examples.output: A soft custom palette with botanical greens, warm neutrals, and readable sans-serif typography is prepared for review.

best_practices: Review the showcase before selecting a theme.
Keep one theme consistent across the full artifact.
Check contrast and readability after applying colors and fonts.
anti_patterns: Mixing several themes in one artifact without a clear design reason.
Changing content structure while applying visual styling.
Using a theme that conflicts with the audience or subject matter.

faq.question: What can this skill style?
faq.answer: It can guide styling for slides, documents, reports, and HTML landing pages.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes with color palettes, fonts, and suggested use cases.

faq.question: Can it create a custom theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate a new theme from user direction and show it for review before application.

faq.question: Does it edit the showcase PDF?
faq.answer: No. The PDF is used as a visual reference for choosing themes.

faq.question: Does it run external styling tools?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides instructions and theme specifications, not executable automation scripts.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
